title: Please fix apple watch app issue
body: Hi, I just purchased the membership and like it so far BUT the apple watch app sucks! Majority of the time it doesn't connect and says No Energy Data, also the watch app is very simple with no watch widgets. I look forward to upcoming updates. Thanks
author: TheReviewersreview

title: Not designed for Irregular Work Hours.
body: I am a Restaurant Manager, so I work late afternoons and nights. The AI automatically slotted an exercise time while I’m at work. It slotted the one laundry to-do task I created while I’m scheduled for deep work time. The AI doesn’t seem to understand that my schedule is different and I’m awake at night and sleeping during the day. I’m canceling my subscription because y’all have more training to do for this AI, it’s not ready for irregular work hours!
author: blanquita2010

title: Needs Improvement, but good premise!
body:
There are a ton of apps that claim to do what Lifestack does, but no one does it better so far! Still, though, this app is missing a lot of features, and the most glaring being that it’s missing a feature to plan your entire week. Along with a few bugs that has events overlapping. Excited to see the future of this app, but not worth the money at this point.

Especially given how expensive it is. Like wow are they upcharging. This app literally just uses Google’s Gemini and they expect you to pay 111 dollars for a lifetime sub?? Insanity.

title: Amazing calendar app, uses your circadian rhythm to make a better schedule
body:
Lifestack is hands down the best smart calendar I’ve ever used. It’s not just a regular daily planner—it’s an AI calendar that adapts to your personal energy levels. The energy tracking feature is a game changer, helping me schedule important tasks during my peak productivity hours.

If you’re tired of standard planners and want a tool that actually works with you, Lifestack is the app to try. It’s helped me stay organized, save time, and achieve more. Highly recommend it to anyone looking to boost their productivity!

title: If you track your fitness and have a schedule you need this app!
body: This is the app you need if you’re tracking your fitness and have a busy schedule. I can’t begin to explain how effective I’ve become since scheduling more demanding tasks at work when the app notes my high energy/low energy throughout the day. There’s no other app on the market that’ll let you not only see you current schedule with your energey peaks overlay, but lets you also sync tasks from 3rd party platforms like Trello. Look no further, this is the mobile application you need for you fitness trackers and health optimizers out there.
